fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Mark each structure with a visible identifier so responders can quickly distinguish and communicate between buildings on scene.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach all structures without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a designated turnaround area near the structures so responding vehicles are not forced to back out onto the main road.
• Keep a gate or barrier at the single access point unlocked or equipped with a Knox-style lock box to prevent delayed entry.
• Maintain the open terrain between structures free of equipment, stored materials, or debris that would block emergency vehicle movement across the property.
• Identify an exterior staging area large enough for multiple vehicles that does not block the access drive.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Clear dry grass within 30 feet of the house, garage, and any outbuildings.
• Trim the lower branches of scattered trees near structures so flames cannot climb from ground vegetation into the tree canopy.
• Remove shrubs that are directly adjacent to or touching any structure.
• Thin shrubs in clusters near structures to create open gaps between individual plants.
• Keep dry grass mowed short along both sides of the driveway for its full length to maintain the single access route.
• Trim any tree branches that overhang the driveway to keep the route clear for vehicles.
• Remove dead or dry ground vegetation that has accumulated near the base of trees close to structures.
• Keep the area around the garage and any outbuildings free of dry grass and loose plant material.
• Clear dry grass and loose vegetation from open terrain immediately surrounding the house.
